Name: Recoloring Tools (Scythe Pan etc)
Author: deleted176058330
Description:
This mod through configuration lets you recolor your farming tools to match your other tools! It doesnt change anything except the texture of the tools (it doesnt rename them either).

All tools have 10 variants: [i]base, copper, iron, gold, iridium, galaxy, [i]infinity, dwarf, dragontooth and radioactive[/i][/i]. By default they all their original color. You can change it with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ or via [i]config.json[/i] file that will appear in the mod folder after the first launch of the game.

There are 7 changeable tools:﻿
[list]
[*]﻿Scythe
[*]Golden Scythe
[*]Copper Pan (and its hat)
[*]Milk Pail
[*]Shears
[*]Return Scepter (Return Scepter is a bit unique because you can change it rod and gem separately! The gem has 8 variants: [i]amethyst, emerald, ruby, topaz, diamond, aquamarine, jade and prismatic[/i])
[*]Horse Flute
[/list]You can also toggle off and on all of them separately if you want to.

This mod is inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2445]Scythe and Copper Pan Recolors[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10569]Matching Tools - Iridium Pan and hat[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10560]Matching Tools - Iridium Scythe[/url]

This mod doesnt rename items and change animation when panning, playing flute or cutting with shears. I may add it in the future but not 100% sure.
